core.kinds.webhook.title: Webhook
core.kinds.webhook.description: Sends events to a URL of your choice as they happen, signed so the receiver can check they came from this server. Deliveries that fail are tried again for most of a day, and every attempt is kept in the webhook's delivery log.
core.kinds.webhook.actions.test.title: Send a test
core.kinds.webhook.actions.test.descript: Sends a core.webhook.ping event to the webhook right away and reports how the receiver answered. Test deliveries aren't tried again.
core.kinds.webhook.actions.redeliver.des: Sends the event of an earlier delivery once more, as a new delivery that is tried again on the usual schedule if it fails.
